decision.explanation: The question asks when the Museum for the Macedonian Struggle was established. Multiple documents provide conflicting dates for the establishment of the museum, likely referring to different museums or aspects of the same institution. Document D1S4 states the museum was established in 1980, while D4S1 claims it was established in 1955. D5S4 mentions 1920, D6S2 refers to 23 May 2010, and D9S4 and D11S1 both cite 1989. These discrepancies suggest either multiple museums with similar names or differing interpretations of what constitutes 'establishment.' All provided dates are preserved as valid referents.
